# Wildfire sensor pilot overview

The Wildfire Sensor Pilot evaluates a camera and sensor network designed to identify wildfire risks near utility vegetation corridors. It matters by enabling early detection of sparks, smoke, or heat anomalies that precede outages or fire spread. Key vocabulary includes “sensor nodes” (camera and thermal units), “risk zones” (high-threat vegetation areas), and “alert thresholds” (pre-set triggers for anomalies). Typically, this pilot is owned by the Utility Risk Operations team, collaborating with Field Inspection and Data Analytics groups to refine detection accuracy and response protocols.
